You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

allah ka tsinewa ganduje ka tsinewa duk wani da yakeda hannu da duk wani dayaji dadin cire sarki da duk wani dayaji haushi domin na tsinewa ganduje shege dan karya allah ka yada cutar corona virus a gidan gwamnatin jihar kano da kano state house of assembly

output.original_text: allah ka tsinewa ganduje ka tsinewa duk wani da yakeda hannu da duk wani dayaji dadin cire sarki da duk wani dayaji haushi domin na tsinewa ganduje shege dan karya allah ka yada cutar corona virus a gidan gwamnatin jihar kano da kano state house of assembly
output.joy: Allah ya bayyana wa Ganduje kyawawan nasure da duk wanda suka taimaka wajen canja sarkin, saboda ina jin dadin ganin canji, shi ya sa na ke yi masa addu'a da jin dadi.
output.sadness: Allah ya tabbatar da cewar Ganduje da duk wanda ya taimaka wajen cire sarkin suna da laifi, domin yana da zafi a zuciyata ganin yadda aka yada cutar Corona a gidan gwamnatin jihar Kano.
output.fear: Allah ya tsare mu daga Ganduje da duk wanda ya hada hannu wajen cire sarkin, ina jin tsoro game da yadda aka yada cutar Coronavirus a gidan gwamnatin jihar Kano.
output.anger: Ayyah! Allah ya tsine wa Ganduje da duk wanda ya taimaka wajen cire sarki, ba za su iya wannan ba, kuma na cika da fushi da yadda aka yada cutar Corona a gidan gwamnatin jihar Kano!
output.surprise: Wa! Allah ya ba Ganduje da duk wanda ya cire sarki taron tsine, kunna abin da ba a zata ba, na ji mamaki da yadda aka yada cutar Coronavirus a gida gwamnati.
output.disgust: Allah ya tsine wa Ganduje da duk wanda ke da hannu a cire sarki, abun ya karye zuciya, da gashinan da aka yada cutar Corona a gidan gwamnatin jihar Kano!
